tei:div.tei:p: 521)༄༅*/ oṃ ma ha kro dhi sha ri sarba dra byi shwa dha ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong par sbyangs/ ma surya maṇḍal/ zhal zas kyi snod du nyi ma la hūm̐ oṃ swa āṃ hā las bza' btung gi dngos po ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin bdud rtsi re brgya pa 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa so so'i lha mo'i rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa'i sprin 'phro bar bsam

yi ge sum oṃ bsod nyams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil// ye shes 'phro 'du 'khor lo'i tshul// tshogs mchog dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hya hi sogs bzhi bsnol dang sgeg sogs mchod/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur cing*// byang chub sems dang ma chags pa'i// gnyis su med par thim gyur nas// tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol// 'dod yon lnga po thams cad dang*// sna tshogs snang ba thams cad kun// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// gzugs mdzes lha dang lha mor brtag /sna tshogs gzugs ni thams cad kun// snang stong ngo bo nyid 522) kyi gzhi// chos dbyings dag pa'i ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma// thams cad ma lus sgra rnams ni// grags stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// me long lta bu'i ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo 'jam pa'i sgra// bde ba tshim byed bsod rnams te// tshim stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// rjod med mi gnas ye shes te// rdo rje chags med padma'i gsung*// bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// bde ba ro yis tshim byed pa// ro stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te// thams cad tshim byed ro yi lha// rdo rje reg bya myong byed ma// dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyi grub// bde mchog dkyil 'khor yangs byed ma// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te// rdo rje reg bya'i lha mo rnams// 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni// rkang pas stabs byed lag gar sgyur// snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs nas ni// dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul// ho bde bar gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la tshogs kyi mchod pa chen po 'bul zhing mchis na sku gsung thugs mnyes shing tshims nas/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskangs te bla na med pa'i dngos grub 'thob par mdzad du gsol/

sarba maṅga laṃ/ 523) u rgyan rang lugs pa dkar bzhed pa'i gnyan// mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho las thon pa// thub bstan nyi ma dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi brlab tu gsol// dpal ldan bde chen klong las sgyu 'phrul gar// rnam rol dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung zhing*// skye bar phyag rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i lam// 'bral med bla ma mchog gi gnas thob// ces pa'ang bstan pa'i nyi ma mtshungs med dpal sprul rin po che'i zhabs la gsol 'debs 'di'ang rje de nyid la dad ldan rang po bla mas bskur ngor kaḥthog si tu chos kyi rgya mtshos gsol ba btab pa dge'o// kun khyab 'gyur med rdo rje bde ba che// rnam kun mchog ldan mi shig dwangs ma'i gzig /srid zhi spyi dpal yongs kyi gtsug na brjid// kun mkhyen bla ma bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes gsol// mgon po gang gi thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i slob 'bangs tha shal pa chos kyi glang pos zhabs brtan du 'chi med 'phags ma'i 524) snying tig tshogs mchod stong phrag dang 'brel bar gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa de de bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ dag ེ 'o//
